description: OpenMHC reimplementation of Apple's WBM: bidirectional Mamba2 contrastive SSL encoder, a week of 168 hourly steps x 19 channels -> 256-d representation.

checkpoint.load: torch.load(weights_only=True); keys prefixed model./encoder. are stripped as in OpenMHC _load_wbm_encoder; a missing key is an error

architecture_source.use: Fetched at run time from the pinned commit and hash-checked; not copied into this repository.

input.alignment: seven local calendar days, local midnight to local midnight
input.layout: [(value - mean) / std * present | missing], 38 features; missing = 1 where unknown
input.hourly_aggregation: accumulations (steps, distance, flights, energy) nansum; heart rate nanmean; binary sleep/workout nanmax (OpenMHC forecasting_evaluation/INTERNALS.md)
input.heart_rate_unit: beats per second: OpenMHC's normalization mean 1.2439 (74.6 bpm) and its extractors' *60 conversion; the CHANNEL_UNITS label 'bpm' is not the stored unit
input.output: r: unweighted mean over all 168 tokens of the backbone sequence, before the projection head (256-d)

declared.where: Hugging Face model card and repo metadata at the pinned revision

license.relied_on: CC BY 4.0, as stated where the weights are distributed (the pinned Hugging Face revision), with attribution to the MyHeartCounts/OpenMHC authors and arXiv 2607.16235.
license.conservative_constraints: Because the README says OpenRAIL, Hachi also applies the stricter reading until the authors resolve it: research evaluation only, no redistribution of the checkpoint or any derived/fine-tuned model, no medical-advice use, weights stay outside Git.
license.citation: OpenMHC benchmark (arXiv 2607.16235); Apple, Beyond Sensor Data (arXiv 2507.00191).

pretraining_cohort: My Heart Counts training split (iPhone/Apple Watch, HealthKit). No known overlap with PMData (Fitbit Versa 2, Norway); recorded as 'none' with this rationale.
